items.question: "What about spare parts from China? Will I have to wait a month?"
items.answer: No. We keep key parts in Poland - seals, filters, buckets, hydraulic components, etc. For our mini excavators, we use components compatible with KOOP, Briggs & Stratton, and Kubota, available from Polish distributors. Typical service response time: 24h.

items.question: "Who is going to repair it? No service shop knows these machines."
items.answer: We will. We have our own mobile technical service team. The engines in our machines are standard units - any experienced mechanic can handle them. Each machine comes with a Polish-language user manual and spare parts catalog.

items.question: "At this price, something must be wrong"
items.answer: Ask our customers what they think about our mini excavators. We will gladly provide contact details for someone who uses our mini excavators, for example on a construction site. A first-hand opinion means more than ours.

promise.title: Ready to work from day one

You buy a machine fully prepared for work, with no hidden surprises. You do not need to do anything - once delivered, you can start working immediately.

items.q: How do I transport the excavator to the construction site?
items.a: Our mini excavators fit on a standard car trailer up to 3.5 t GVW. Transporting them on a trailer with a passenger car is not a problem.

items.q: How long does it take to receive the machine?
items.a: Machines available from stock are delivered within 5–14 business days. Made-to-order models are delivered within 3–4 weeks. We confirm current availability when preparing the quotation.

items.q: Can I buy it for my company and use leasing?
items.a: Yes. We issue VAT invoices for both companies and private individuals. We cooperate with leasing companies - the installment for a BM12 machine is around PLN 650-800 per month with a 60-month lease.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after a year?
items.a: The warranty covers 12 months. After it ends, we offer paid mobile service and spare parts sales from our Polish warehouse.

items.q: Can I test the machine before buying?
items.a: Yes - we invite you to a presentation at our showroom in Poznań. You can personally test the machine in operation. Contact us to arrange a date.

items.q: Are the mini excavators new? Do they have CE certificates?
items.a: All machines are brand new and come with a CE declaration of conformity. We provide full technical documentation and a user manual in Polish.

gwarancja.title: Warranty terms
gwarancja.intro: This document sets out the rules for granting and performing the warranty for Bergson Machines branded Goods. The document forms an integral part of the Bergson Machines Sales Terms and Conditions.

blocks.text: The warranty for Bergson Machines branded Goods is granted by Better Solutions Spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością, with its registered office in Czapury (61-160), ul. Poznańska 7, KRS: 0000837608, NIP: 7252298652, hereinafter referred to as the Warrantor.
The warranty is granted voluntarily and does not exclude, limit, or suspend the Buyer’s rights arising from the provisions on non-conformity of goods with the contract.

The warranty covers physical defects of the Goods resulting from causes inherent in the Goods themselves, provided that they are used under normal operating conditions in accordance with the user manual supplied by the Warrantor.

items: BM10, BM12, BM12C mini excavators - 12 months from the date the Goods are handed over to the Buyer;
working attachments (buckets, hammers, augers) - 12 months from the date of delivery;
spare parts supplied as part of a warranty repair - 3 months or until the end of the original warranty period, whichever expires later.
mechanical, electrical, or hydraulic damage caused by the Buyer or third parties;
defects resulting from improper operation, maintenance, or installation of attachments contrary to the instructions;
natural wear and tear of consumable parts, in particular filters, oils, seals, rubber hoses, rubber and steel tracks, bulbs, and fuses;
damage caused by using the Goods contrary to their intended purpose, overloading, or lack of regular service inspections;
defects caused by using non-original spare parts or operating fluids not approved by the manufacturer;
damage resulting from force majeure, including flood, fire, lightning, or frost below the permissible operating temperature;
Goods with tampered or illegible serial numbers.

blocks.text: Step 1 - Reporting the defect. The Buyer is required to report the defect immediately after discovering it, no later than within 14 days, by e-mail to: kontakt@bergsonmachines.pl.

items: a detailed description of the identified defect together with photographic or video documentation;
the machine serial number from the nameplate;
the purchase date and a copy of the proof of purchase, in particular a VAT invoice or receipt;
the Buyer’s contact details and the location of the Goods.

blocks.text: Step 2 - Evaluation of the claim. The Warrantor confirms receipt of the claim within 2 business days and indicates whether the repair will be carried out at the place where the Goods are used or whether the Goods should be delivered to a service point.

Step 3 - Performance. The Warrantor reviews the warranty claim and begins processing it within 14 business days from its proper submission. If the claim is accepted, the Warrantor, at its sole discretion, will repair the Goods, deliver and install a spare part, or replace the Goods with defect-free Goods.
Step 4 - Collection of the Goods. After the repair is completed, the Warrantor notifies the Buyer that the Goods are ready for collection or arranges their delivery at the Warrantor’s expense.

The costs of delivering the Goods to the service point and collecting them after the warranty repair are borne by the Warrantor, provided that the defect is recognized as covered by the warranty. If the claim proves unjustified, the transport and diagnostic costs are borne by the Buyer.

The Warrantor may issue the Buyer with a warranty card in paper or electronic form. The absence of a warranty card does not deprive the Buyer of warranty rights — proof of purchase is sufficient to exercise them.

zwroty-i-reklamacje.title: Returns and complaints
zwroty-i-reklamacje.intro: This document sets out the rules for submitting complaints and exercising the right of withdrawal from the contract. The document forms an integral part of the Bergson Machines Sales Terms and Conditions.

sections.heading: Complaint due to non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract

blocks.text: The Seller is liable for non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract under the rules set out in the Act of 30 May 2014 on consumer rights — in relations with Consumers — and under the Civil Code — in relations with B2B Buyers.
The Seller is liable for non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract existing at the time of delivery and revealed within two years from that moment.

items: demand repair of the Goods;
demand replacement of the Goods with defect-free Goods;
demand a price reduction — if repair or replacement is impossible, excessively costly, or the Seller has refused to perform it;
withdraw from the Contract and receive a full refund — if the non-conformity is material and repair or replacement proved ineffective or the Seller refused to perform it.

blocks.text: It is presumed that any non-conformity revealed within one year from delivery of the Goods already existed at the time of delivery, unless the Seller proves otherwise.
In relations with B2B Buyers, liability under statutory warranty is excluded pursuant to Article 558 § 1 of the Civil Code.
A B2B Buyer may pursue claims solely under the Warranty described in the Bergson Machines Warranty Terms document or under terms individually agreed with the Seller in writing.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal from the Contract — Consumers

blocks.text: A Consumer who concluded a distance contract or an off-premises contract has the right to withdraw from it without stating a reason within 14 days from the day on which the Goods came into the Consumer’s possession.

The right of withdrawal does not apply if the Goods were manufactured or modified according to the Consumer’s individual specification, are Goods imported on special production order, or have clearly deteriorated for reasons attributable to the Consumer.

items: sending an unequivocal statement of withdrawal to the e-mail address: kontakt@bergsonmachines.pl or in writing to the Seller’s registered office — before the expiry of the 14-day period;
returning the Goods within 14 days from the date of submitting the statement, in unchanged condition and, if possible, in the original packaging, to the address indicated by the Seller;
bearing the direct costs of returning the Goods, unless the Seller has expressly agreed to cover them.

blocks.text: The Seller refunds all payments received, including standard delivery costs, without undue delay and no later than within 14 days from the date of receiving the withdrawal statement. The Seller may withhold the refund until receiving the Goods or confirmation that they have been sent back.

A complaint due to non-conformity of the Goods with the Contract or warranty rights should be submitted by e-mail, in writing, or through an authorized Bergson Machines dealer from whom the Goods were purchased.

items: the Buyer’s full name and contact details;
the order number or VAT invoice number;
the serial number of the Goods;
a detailed description of the defect or non-conformity together with photographic or video documentation;
the Buyer’s request, in particular repair, replacement, price reduction, or refund.

blocks.text: The Seller reviews the complaint and responds within 14 calendar days in the case of a Consumer and within 14 business days in the case of a B2B Buyer submitting a warranty complaint.
Lack of a response to the Consumer within 14 calendar days means that the complaint is deemed justified. The response is sent by e-mail or in writing — at the Buyer’s request.

items: mediation conducted by the competent Trade Inspection Inspectorate;
proceedings before the Permanent Consumer Arbitration Court at the Trade Inspection;
the ODR online dispute resolution platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr.

blocks.text: The Seller is not obliged to use out-of-court dispute resolution methods but may consent to participate in a specific proceeding.

seoContent.label: Guide
seoContent.title: Mini excavators for sale - how to choose the right model?
seoContent.lead: A mini excavator is equipment that works well both for construction and installation jobs as well as on private properties. Choosing the right machine weight, attachments, and availability of service and spare parts in Poland is crucial.

blocks.title: 1 ton or 1.2 tons?
blocks.text: 1-ton models work better in tight spaces and for lighter jobs. 1.2-ton mini excavators offer greater stability and efficiency, which is why they are a common choice for companies carrying out more demanding earthworks.

blocks.title: How much does a mini excavator cost?
blocks.text: The price depends on the configuration, engine, cabin presence, and additional attachments. In practice, owning your own machine is very often more beneficial than regular renting, especially for ongoing jobs.

blocks.title: Service and spare parts in Poland
blocks.text: When buying, it is not only the machine itself that matters, but also the availability of spare parts and the speed of service response. These are the elements that have the greatest impact on reducing downtime and the real operating cost.

seoContent.footerText: Check the available models, compare attachments, and choose a configuration tailored to the type of work you do most often.
